fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting on alleged A. & P. grocery-chain practices and its advertising campaign; coverage of a letter from the U.S. Department of Justice, Immigration and Naturalization Service disputing statements about an investigation of Jose Aleman; local Miami municipal politics including candidate statements for city commission and discussion of city management and policing; reports on alleged police brutality and related hearings; articles on minors using falsified draft cards and drivers’ licenses to obtain alcohol; traffic-safety messaging; and local consumer/utility topics including telephone rates and directory advertising.
